Qwen3-ASR 0.6B Full-Transcript Error Corrector Bundle
	

Self-contained release bundle for training and inference with Qwen3-ASR error correctors.

	
		
	
	
		Contents
	


ckpt/ — recognizer and error-corrector checkpoints
data/ — training JSONL and bundled Waihu test set
scripts/ — setup, training, and evaluation scripts
third_party/ — StreamCorrect and ms-swift dependencies


	
		
	
	
		Usage
	

Unzip and follow scripts/README.md inside the archive.

	
		
	
	
		Training audio… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/playwithmino/qwen3asr_0p6b_correctors_20260525_hf_clean.
